description: Read and organize mail, send messages, manage mailboxes and vacation responses.

fastmail_new_email_trigger.description: Runs for each new email in Fastmail. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, threadId, mailboxIds, keywords, subject, receivedAt, preview, to, textBody, bodyValues, from

fastmail_new_mailbox_trigger.description: Runs for each new mailbox in Fastmail. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, parentId, role, sortOrder, totalEmails, unreadEmails

fastmail_new_or_updated_email_trigger.description: Runs for each email added or changed in Fastmail. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, threadId, mailboxIds, keywords, subject, receivedAt, preview, to, textBody, bodyValues, from

fastmail_new_or_updated_mailbox_trigger.description: Runs for each mailbox added or changed in Fastmail. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, parentId, role, sortOrder, totalEmails, unreadEmails
